items.question: Do I need a credit card to sign up?
items.answer: No. The Basic plan is completely free and requires no credit card. You only need an email address.

items.question: How do new clients find me?
items.answer: Activate your public profile, share your /u/your-business link, and if you meet the publishability criteria you can appear in the /providers directory. Visitors send quote requests; Solennix facilitates contact — it does not intermediate the service or the event payments.

items.question: Can I import my existing data?
items.answer: Yes. You can import clients from CSV or Excel. We also offer assisted migration for Pro accounts.

items.question: Is my data safe?
items.answer: Absolutely. We use end-to-end encryption, automatic daily backups, and SOC 2 certified servers.

items.question: Can I cancel at any time?
items.answer: Yes, with no penalties or lock-in contracts. You can cancel whenever you want and keep access until the end of the paid period.
